findings.text: Empty completed response leaves no usage boundary
findings.motivation: The context meter and model-facing usage note must reflect the latest response only; a completely empty completed stream stores no step, so an older token count can still be shown as current.
findings.behavior: retainResponseUsage returns [] for an empty response with usage {} (deliberately, to avoid a blank transcript card), so lastUsedTokens falls back to the previous response's figure.
findings.approach: Track response completion and unknown-usage state separately from transcript steps (e.g. a non-rendered conversation field or a hidden boundary marker that placeStepsForModel drops), then test an empty completion after a numeric response.
findings.success_signal: An empty completed stream after a numeric response yields an unknown meter and a number-free note, with no visible transcript card.

findings.text: Cap 4xx error-body read within a single chunk
findings.motivation: The stream_options fallback reads 4xx bodies with an 8 KiB cap, but the cap is only checked between chunks.
findings.behavior: readBoundedBody decodes a whole chunk before checking the byte count, so a large single chunk is scanned in full and a field name beyond byte 8192 can still trigger the retry.
findings.approach: Decode only value.subarray(0, maxBytes - bytes) and cancel the reader once the cap is reached; add a test with one oversized chunk and the field name beyond byte 8192.
findings.success_signal: An oversized single-chunk 4xx body is decoded only up to 8 KiB and a field name beyond the cap does not trigger a retry.
